Callout.Name: Child Welfare Concern
Callout.Message: Children left alone at an address, neighbour concerned.
Callout.Advisory: Two children, no adults seen for hours.

Script.Line: They are asleep upstairs. I look in on them every hour.
I went out for twenty minutes. Twenty minutes, that is all.
Their mother is coming back tonight. She is on a late shift.

Lines.Approach: Nobody has been in or out for most of the day and the children are on their own. The neighbour is sure.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
